name: File Browser
description: Access and manage your files from any browser on your network.
fullDescription:
File Browser provides a clean web interface for managing files on your Mac. Browse, upload, download, and organize files from any device on your network — no Finder sharing or SMB setup required.

Key features:
• Browse and manage files from any web browser
• Upload and download files and folders
• Create, rename, and delete files with a simple UI
• Share files with direct download links
• Built-in text editor and media preview
• Lightweight single binary — minimal resource usage
• No authentication required on your local network
